Subject: POC kickoff | NovaHealth - post-call recap & MAP

Hi Tom / Lara,

Thanks again for the call today — it was helpful to understand NovaHealth's goals for a patient-facing summarization feature. Quick recap and the mutual action plan we agreed on: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood for generating concise patient encounter summaries from clinical notes (avg. 400-800 tokens)
- Success metrics: 90% tooling coverage for top 3 specialties, avg. latency < 200ms p50 for single-concurrent interactive flow, and cost targets we discussed
- POC scope: 2-week trial, 3 internal users, integration using our hosted API + prefix caching config
- Next steps (owners):
  1) Redwood to provision trial environment + sample prompts (Marissa) — by end of week
  2) NovaHealth infra to whitelist Redwood IPs & provide test dataset (Tom/Lara) — before kickoff
  3) Kickoff call to validate access and run initial tests — propose Mon Aug 2, 10:00 AM PT

I've attached a short SOC2 summary and a POC setup playbook that walks through the minimal steps for onboarding (API keys, whitelisting, sample requests). Also adding the HubSpot kickoff checklist here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/10293/DEAL-2026-042

If Monday 10am PT doesn't work, send 2 alternative times and I'll get it on the calendar. I can also run the security call if your IT team wants a quick 20-minute run-through.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

—

Hi Tom — thanks for the update and totally understand. I've looped in Rafael (our security/compliance lead) to help fast-track answers for your security team. Quick answers below you can share immediately: 

- Data retention: By default, API request/response logs are retained for 30 days in the hosted trial environment. We can configure retention per contract; we also offer options for shorter retention or customer-managed retention in Private deployments.
- PII redaction: We provide configurable PII redaction; by default, sensitive fields are redacted in logs and the POC environment uses token-level masking for names/emails on request samples.
- Audit logs: Audit logs for API key usage and role changes are available and can be exported as CSV. For enterprise customers we can provide S3 delivery of audit exports.

I've attached the SOC2 one-pager again for your security team and can set up a 20-minute call between Rafael and your security lead to go over any follow-ups. Proposed times for a short security sync: Tue Aug 3, 10:00 AM PT or Wed Aug 4, 2:00 PM PT — let me know which works and I'll send an invite.

If you'd still prefer to postpone the kickoff, no problem — what's the best time window next week for your team?
